articles.title: Crypto political group plans to spend $30 million against Sherrod Brown's Senate bid
articles.snippet: It's the biggest spending from the industry's campaign arm in 2026, much like Fairshake's $40 million against Brown two years ago was its largest-ever outlay.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia exits China-backed mBridge CBDC project: FT
articles.snippet: Saudi Arabia has left mBridge, a cross-border CBDC platform that has drawn scrutiny from US policymakers, according to the Financial Times.

articles.title: US Probes Whether Binance 'Knowingly' Let Iran-Linked Trades Through: Report
articles.snippet: Binance says it has a "zero-tolerance policy" for sanctions violations. Prosecutors are asking whether its 2023 compliance fixes held.
